'''Lorka''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He had a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operation in the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] but it was annihilated by [[Reog's Regiment]].<ref name="Dangerous Covenants" />
